description: This file defines a CMake function 'map_issubsetof' that recursively checks if one map (or list) is a subset of another within a CMake build system. It performs key lookups, type checks, and recursive subset tests.

methods.name: map_issubsetof
methods.description: Recursively checks whether the 'subset' is a subset of 'superset' by comparing keys and values, handling nested maps and lists.
